title: PanKbase PCA Explorer
bodyHtml:
PCA Explorer

Investigate interactive Principal Component Analyses (PCA) of pseudo-bulk normalized RNA expression categorized by cell type. For each cell type, gain insights into how samples are distinguished based on biological or technical variables, such as diabetes status, age, and sequencing chemistry. Hover over individual points to access additional donor information. To learn more about the methods used for these analyses, see here. To examine differential gene expression analyses with corrections for technical variations, please visit the Differential Gene Expression Browser.
